# External dependencies

Vendored third-party code. Each directory has a `README.md` with version, license and update steps; targets are declared in `CMakeLists.txt` as `ext::<name>`.

| Directory | Library | Version | License | Upstream |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`imgui/`](imgui/README.md) | Dear ImGui | 1.90.1 WIP | MIT | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui |
| [`imgui_club/`](imgui_club/README.md) | imgui_club — memory editor | imgui_memory_editor v0.50 | MIT | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui_club |
| [`imguifiledialog/`](imguifiledialog/README.md) | ImGuiFileDialog | v0.6.5 | MIT (bundled `dirent`: MIT, `stb`: MIT / Unlicense) | https://github.com/aiekick/ImGuiFileDialog |
| [`directxtex/`](directxtex/README.md) | DirectXTex | `DIRECTX_TEX_VERSION` 198 | MIT | https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXTex |
| [`peglib/`](peglib/README.md) | cpp-peglib | see `peglib.h` | MIT | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-peglib |
| [`nlohmann_json/`](nlohmann_json/README.md) | JSON for Modern C++ | 3.11.2 | MIT | https://github.com/nlohmann/json |
| [`rapidcsv/`](rapidcsv/README.md) | rapidcsv | 8.80 | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/d99kris/rapidcsv |
| [`stb/`](stb/README.md) | stb_image_write | 1.16 | MIT OR Unlicense | https://github.com/nothings/stb |
| [`murmurhash3/`](murmurhash3/README.md) | MurmurHash3 | smhasher (no releases) | Public domain | https://github.com/aappleby/smhasher |
| [`tinytiff/`](tinytiff/README.md) | TinyTIFF | 5.0.0.0 (git `d5f6582`) | LGPL-3.0-or-later | https://github.com/jkriege2/TinyTIFF |
| [`bass/`](bass/README.md) | BASS / BASS_FX | BASS 2.4, BASS_FX 2.4.12 | Proprietary — free for non-commercial use | https://www.un4seen.com (BASS_FX: https://www.jobnik.org) |
